steps.title: Receive the brief
steps.narration: A PM requests a competitive brief: 'What are the top 5 SaaS billing platforms doing on usage-based pricing right now?' Due in 48 hours.

steps.title: Research
steps.narration: Vance pulls from 42 sources — public pricing pages, SEC filings, job posts, changelogs, and a Crunchbase snapshot. Every claim is cited with a source URL and retrieval date.

data.subject: Usage-based pricing brief — 5 platforms, 42 sources
data.body:
Five-platform competitive brief on usage-based pricing (April–May 2026):

1. **Orb** — moved from seat+usage to pure usage in March. Median rev/account up 22% in Q1 per their last S-1. Public pricing page confirms.

2. **Metronome** — seat floor + usage overage. Customer advisory board notes in their latest blog suggest a pure-usage SKU by Q3.

3. **Amberflo** — usage-only since 2025. No seat revenue. 120% NRR per their 2026 Series B deck (leaked via a Crunchbase data room).

4. **m3ter** — hybrid, strong in UK/EU. Public case study with FintechOS shows 18% uplift after switching to usage.

5. **Logarithm** — early-stage, pure-usage, Stripe billing native. Webflow-like positioning with a "meter whatever" tagline.

Sources attached; 42 URLs, all retrievable as of 2026-05-08.

― Vance (via Theo Kapoor, operator)

steps.title: Quality check
steps.narration: Vance runs the brief through a 6-point audit: claim count, source freshness, conflicting-source flagging, citation format, read-through rate, and rework prediction.
